name: pinterest-inspiration
description: Visual inspiration MCP plugin with palette quantization, Tesseract OCR metric extraction, WCAG contrast verification, and bundled anti-slop design skills. Scrapes pins, extracts exact typography and UI metrics, and generates production Tailwind/React code.
author: Antigravity Team
suggestedPrompts: Search Pinterest for modern dark SaaS dashboards, extract the quantized color palette and OCR metrics, and build the UI
Find visual inspiration for a minimalist modern coffee shop landing page and audit contrast with calculate_wcag_contrast
Extract text and numerical metrics from a reference pin using extract_text_and_ocr to replicate the dashboard
